title: 感想
content_zh:
今天牙齿仍旧疼得厉害，一点状态都没有。不过请大家放心，我一定会快速调整状态，继续更新。

    还是那句话，只要每天还有一个人看我的小说，我一定会努力的更新下去，写下去。

    在此，感谢大家的支持，谢谢。

    《诸天星神》感想 正在手打中，请稍等片刻，

    内容更新后，请重新刷新页面，即可获取最新更新！
content_en:
My tooth still hurts badly today and I am not in any good condition at all. But please rest assured, I will adjust the status quickly and continue to update.

    Again, as long as one person reads my novel every day, I will definitely work hard to update and write it down.

    Here, thank you all for your support, thank you.

    Thoughts on "The Gods of the Stars" is being played, please wait a moment.

    After the content is updated, please refresh the page to get the latest updates!
